translations.text: Lord God almighty, I, a sinner, confess to you, and to Saint Mary, and to all God's angels, and to all God's saints, and to you, God's priest, all my sins and all my misdeeds,

whatever wrong I ever did, or wrongly thought, or wrongly spoke, from my baptism until this present day, those I remember and those I do not remember, those I did knowingly and those I did unknowingly,
under compulsion or without compulsion, sleeping or waking, by day or by night, in whatever place or at whatever time I committed them, by myself or with another:
in unbelief, in sorcery, in pride, in wantonness, in envy, in jealousy, in hatred, in enmity, in wrath, in false oaths, in false testimony,
in lies, in manslaughter, in thefts, in robberies by force, in deceit, in faithlessness, in fornication, in adultery, in defilement of my body,
in lustful desires, in wrongful greed, in slander, in [?], in grumbling, in hypocrisy, in contempt of people, in unjust judgments, in disobedience,
in overeating, in overdrinking, in shameful talk, in vain jesting, in mockery, in faintheartedness, in unjust strife, in boastfulness.
I confess to you, Lord, that I indulged my body more than I should have.
I confess to you, Lord, that I did not visit the infirm, or those who were in prison and in other distress, nor help them as I should have and as I could have.
I confess to you, Lord, that I did not refresh the hungry, nor give drink to the thirsty, nor clothe the naked
